method: Installed Redux GFXM route-control corpus through actual431750 and all default target/speed/steering/pacing references, with no callbacks or original executable execution. Complete decoded resource copies retain all authored group/point bytes; only group+8 pointers are relocated from file point-base-relative offsets, and runtime pack+60 publishes the copied table. Every usable group is sampled at first/middle/last points across nine declared profiles and four persistent ticks. Body/session/wheel/opponent/progression storage is synthetic zeroed memory with explicitly assigned fields. The progression record stays fixed during a scenario. Between ticks, declared linear fixture motion advances position by serialized velocity/4; this is not reconstructed vehicle physics or a captured runtime. Caller resets control bits at each tick. Invariants check source/mapped hashes,bounds and exact point bytes,authored-direction allowed target steps,unrelated body bytes,control widths,one-shot steering suppression,disabled early return and opponent pacing. Mode4/highspeed/special target inputs are declared profiles. No claim about constructor defaults,autonomous strategy outside431750,collision integration or whole-race behavior.
